items.title: Expert group launches £3-a-day food plan for preventing malnutrition
items.summary: A group of multidisciplinary clinicians has launched a seven-day shopping list and meal plan built on the ‘food-first’ approach used in clinical practice, to combat malnutrition in straightened times.

items.title: Save the Date – Edgbaston Clinical Nutrition Course
items.summary: The Edgbaston Clinical Nutrition Course is the 10th & 11th May 2027. Venue: Edgbaston Park Hotel & Conference Centre, Birmingham. Applications open January 2027.

items.title: New Nutrition Support Basket makes affordable, nourishing food easier to put into practice
items.summary: BAPEN has today launched the Nutrition Support Basket, a new practical resource designed to help people at risk of malnutrition get more energy and protein from affordable, everyday foods. Eating enough can be difficult when appetite is low, illness makes eating more challenging or household budgets are stretched.

items.title: ESPEN Symposium comes to Edinburgh in May 2027
items.summary: BAPEN is delighted to be collaborating with the European Society for Clinical Nutrition and Metabolism (ESPEN) to bring the 14th ESPEN Symposium to Edinburgh on 21st – 22nd May 2027.

items.title: New BAPEN and BDA toolkit supports informed choice in blended diet across the lifespan
